scenes.headline: How shuffling a teacher teaches a ViT what objects are
scenes.sub: SiamJEPA's Random Shuffle Teacher removes the position shortcut.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lyra! SiamJEPA predicts a teacher's image patches. Scramble those patches, and see what the model is forced to learn.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Predict latent patches, not pixels. Then shuffle the teacher's target patches so a patch can only be predicted if it encodes what-object-it-is.
scenes.say: A masked model can cheat with position. Shuffle the teacher's targets, and that shortcut is gone.

scenes.title: Two students, one slow teacher, a shuffle

steps.say: Each image is masked twice, into two separate sets of visible patches. Those are the two views.
Both views go through one shared encoder. That is the Siamese pair of students.
A slow moving average of the student, the teacher, reads the whole image and makes the prediction targets.
Here is the trick. After positions are added, the teacher's patches are randomly shuffled.
The students predict that scrambled target. It only works if each token says what it is, not where it sits.

left.title: Ordered teacher
items: Slot i always holds patch i
A token can just encode where it sits
left.say: With an ordered teacher, slot i always holds patch i. A fixed position lookup wins. That is the shortcut.

right.title: Shuffled teacher
items: Slot i holds a random patch
A token must encode what it is
right.say: Shuffle it, and slot i holds a random patch, new every pass. The only way to predict it is a semantic token.

scenes.title: One prediction loss, one alignment loss

parts.say: Sim-2 is the prediction loss: match the teacher's latent patch, in feature space, not pixels.
Sim-1 is a small alignment term between the students, weighted zero point zero one. It is what makes attention object-centric.

scenes.title: What the shuffle does to a token
scenes.note: position decodable from one token; pre-fix, provisional
scenes.say: Probe whether a token still knows its grid position. Without shuffling, ninety-four percent; with it, nineteen. Class accuracy goes up.

scenes.text: Shuffle the teacher's targets and position stops being a shortcut, so each patch has to encode what the object is.

recap: Shuffle the teacher to kill the position shortcut
Numbers are provisional; the mechanism is the point
scenes.say: To recap: predict latent patches, shuffle the teacher to remove the position shortcut, and remember the numbers are still provisional.
